name: tranche-flow
description: Safe multi-agent tranche workflow: refuses git stash (shared across worktrees), /worktree-new from the base branch head, /merge-tranche cherry-picks an agent branch and runs the gate tests file by file against a stored baseline, /agent-ledger records every subagent's tokens and duration and flags heavy ones.

tokenFlag.description: Flag a subagent whose token usage exceeds this (default 300000).
tokenFlag.title: Token flag

allowStash.description: Allow git stash / pop (default false: the stash stack is shared by every worktree).
allowStash.title: Allow git stash
